articles.title: Kubernetes v1.37: etcd RangeStream Cuts Memory Use on Large List Reads
articles.summary: I am excited to announce that etcd RangeStream is graduating to beta in Kubernetes v1.37. Paired with etcd v3.7, it reduces the memory the API server and etcd need to read a large collection, and makes peak usage more predictable. The cost of large reads The API server serves most list and watch requests from its in-memory watch cache.
